description.value:
You can readily unravel a foe's resolve. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When you make a Strength-based attack roll, you can add half your Constitution modifier to it, or when making a Constitution-based attack roll, you can add half your Strength modifier instead. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.

When an effect you control calls for a Strength saving throw, you can substitute a Constitution saving throw, or vice versa when it calls for Constitution. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses on a long rest.
